enableSheetEnhancements.name: Enable STA Officers Log Sheet Enhancements
enableSheetEnhancements.hint: If disabled, this module will not modify the STA character sheet UI on this client (no added buttons, sorting, link controls, or delete confirmations).

showLogUsedToggle.name: Show 'Used' toggle on Logs
showLogUsedToggle.hint: Advanced. Shows the strike-through toggle on Log entries. Normally hidden to prevent accidental changes; 'used' is managed automatically by callback links.

hideChallengedToggle.name: Hide Challenged Value Toggle
hideChallengedToggle.hint: Hides the 'Chal?' toggle on values until the user challenges the value via the "Use Value" button.

enableFlowchartView.name: [EXPERIMENTAL] Enable Mission Log Flowchart
enableFlowchartView.hint: Adds a button to open an interactive flowchart visualization of mission logs and callback chains.

groupShip.name: Group Ship
groupShip.hint: Choose a Starship actor to be treated as the party's Group Ship (stored for later automation).

autoCallbackOnDeterminationRoll.name: Auto-prompt Callback on Determination Rolls
autoCallbackOnDeterminationRoll.hint: If enabled, the GM client will scan new STA roll chat messages for 'Determination', automatically spend 1 Determination for the rolling character, and prompt the player to make a Callback.

talentPickerCustomCompendium.name: Talent Picker: Extra Compendium
talentPickerCustomCompendium.hint: Optional compendium pack id(s) to include in the Talent picker. You can provide multiple pack ids separated by commas (e.g. module-name.talents-homebrew, another-module.more-talents).

talentPickerCustomCompendiumFolderFilter.name: Talent Picker: Filter Custom Compendium by Folder
talentPickerCustomCompendiumFolderFilter.hint: If enabled, talents in custom compendiums will be filtered by folder structure (Crew vs Starship), just like the official STA consolidated packs. Use this if your custom compendium contains both crew and starship talents organized in folders.

focusPickerCustomCompendium.name: Focus Picker: Extra Compendium
focusPickerCustomCompendium.hint: Optional compendium pack id(s) to include in the Focus picker. You can provide multiple pack ids separated by commas (e.g. module-name.focuses-homebrew, another-module.more-focuses).

customSpendOptions.reprimandHint: These appear under a 'Custom' subheader in the Spend Reprimands dialog.

reputationSpend.acclaimHeader: Choose how to spend your acclaim:
reputationSpend.reprimandHeader: Choose how to apply your reprimands:
reputationSpend.noOnlinePlayers: No online players with assigned characters.
reputationSpend.gmSentMessage: The GM has assigned you {amount} {type} to spend.
reputationSpend.gmOnly: Only the GM can use this.
reputationSpend.acclaimCommendAnotherDesc: Commanding officer spends 1 Acclaim to commend another main character, granting them one extra positive influence on their reputation roll (before they roll).
reputationSpend.acclaimElevationDesc: A non-commissioned officer receives a battlefield commission and becomes an officer. If the commanding officer refuses, no Acclaim is spent.
reputationSpend.acclaimGainFavorDesc: Obtain a favor from a non-enemy NPC encountered during the adventure. Base cost 1; +1 if not Starfleet, +1 if they command a starship or similar, +2 if admiral/ambassador/high-ranking.
reputationSpend.acclaimIncreaseReputationDesc: Increase Reputation by 1. Costs Acclaim equal to the new Reputation value (e.g. 3→4 costs 4). Once per adventure.
reputationSpend.acclaimPromotionDesc: Promoted to a higher rank. If the commanding officer refuses, no Acclaim is spent. A commander cannot promote above commander; a captain cannot promote above captain.
reputationSpend.acclaimStatusDesc: Create an additional trait reflecting achievements, recognition, or special status — or remove a negative/detrimental trait. Commanding officers may add a trait to their ship instead.
reputationSpend.awardPikeMedalDesc: Cost 4. Requires command/leadership officer who led crew through several difficult missions with personal danger on at least two. Benefit: Once per mission, when using the Direct task, treat your d20 as if it rolled a 1.
reputationSpend.awardCochraneMedalDesc: Cost 3. Must have significantly contributed to science or engineering (discovery, solution to a long-standing problem). Benefit: (See rulebook for details.)
reputationSpend.awardGrankiteOrderDesc: Cost 3. Awarded for exceptional tactical acumen. Benefit: Once per mission, when creating a strategy/tactic trait, automatically add a level of Potency to it.
reputationSpend.awardKaragiteOrderDesc: Cost 3. Must have faced extreme danger and defended a Federation world/outpost. Benefit: Once per mission, Avoid an Injury for free — or spend 2 Momentum (Immediate) + complication to ignore one ship breach.
reputationSpend.awardLegionOfHonorDesc: Cost 4. No conditions. Benefit: Once per mission, gain 2 bonus Momentum on a successful task (not saveable), or ignore a single complication before its effect is announced.
reputationSpend.awardPalmLeafDesc: Cost 3. Mission must have involved securing peace or signing a peace treaty; all characters in that mission are eligible. Benefit: Once per mission, auto-succeed a Persuade task to prevent violence by spending Momentum equal to Difficulty.
reputationSpend.awardStarCrossDesc: Cost 3. No conditions. Benefit: Once per mission, before a task where a focus applies, double your focus range — score 2 successes for dice equal to or less than twice your department rating.
reputationSpend.awardConspicuousGallantryDesc: Cost 2. Must have succeeded at a heroic, risky, or daring action. Benefit: Once per mission, when paying for Immediate Momentum by adding Threat, roll 1d20; if ≤ Daring, remove 1 Threat.
reputationSpend.awardDecorationGallantryDesc: Cost 2. Must have faced an extremely difficult/dangerous situation and triumphed. Benefit: Once per mission, when suffering an Injury, halve its Severity before avoiding it.
reputationSpend.awardMedalOfHonorDesc: Cost 5. No conditions. May be earned multiple times. Benefit: Once per mission (per medal), gain 2 bonus Momentum on a successful task (not saveable, max once per task).
reputationSpend.awardSurgeonsDecorationDesc: Cost 3. Must be a Medical officer who acted above and beyond to save patients or alleviate a medical crisis. Benefit: Once per mission, reduce the Difficulty of a single Medical task by 2 (min 1).
reputationSpend.reprimandCourtMartialDesc: Arrested and placed on trial. You have the right to legal counsel, and proceedings should be resolved in-game. The court determines guilt or innocence and passes sentence, which can include dishonorable discharge and incarceration.
reputationSpend.reprimandDemotionDesc: Accept demotion from your current rank by one step (e.g. commander to lieutenant commander, or lieutenant to lieutenant junior grade).
reputationSpend.reprimandDetentionDesc: Stripped of duties and locked away for a short duration. A character in detention cannot be used; you must use a supporting character during the next mission.
reputationSpend.reprimandGainAntipathyDesc: Declare an allied NPC from the adventure regards you poorly. Costs 1 normally; +1 if the NPC commands a starship, or +2 if the NPC is an admiral, general, or high-ranking figure.
reputationSpend.reprimandReduceReputationDesc: Reduce your Reputation by 1. Costs Reprimands equal to the Reputation you previously held (e.g. 3→2 costs 3). Once per adventure.
reputationSpend.reprimandShameByAssociationDesc: Commanding officer only. Stain the reputation of others aboard your ship — counts as one extra negative influence on each other main character's reputation roll. Must be done before they roll.
reputationSpend.reprimandStatusDesc: Create a trait reflecting dishonor, cowardice, or disgrace — or remove a positive trait. Commanding officers may add a trait to their ship instead.
reputationSpend.reprimandStrippedOfAwardDesc: Remove one or more of your awards to remove Reprimands. Each award removed uses Reprimands equal to that award's cost.

useValue.title: Use Value: {value}
useValue.positiveDesc:
Use it to help you succeed.
  • -1 Determination
  • Before rolling for a free critical success
  • After rolling to reroll any dice.
useValue.negativeDesc:
Comply with a value in a way that makes things more complicated.
  • +1 Determination
  • Cause a Complication
useValue.challengeDesc:
Change who you are.
  • +1 Determination
  • Value becomes Challenged.
  • Rewrite the value at the end of the mission to remove the Challenged status.

useTrauma.title: Use Trauma: {value}
useTrauma.positiveDesc:
Use it to help you succeed.
  • -1 Determination
  • +{stress} Stress
  • Before rolling for a free critical success
  • After rolling to reroll any dice.
useTrauma.negativeDesc:
Comply with a trauma in a way that makes things more complicated.
  • +1 Determination
  • -2 Stress
  • Cause a Complication
  • Increase Stress recovery by increasing the potency of the complication (1:1).
useTrauma.challengeDesc:
Change who you are.
  • Stress is set to maximum.
  • Trauma becomes Challenged.
  • Trauma is not rewritten. At the start a of a new mission, the Trauma is restored.
